name: Rollganic Rosin Disposable | Snow G
description:
.5g Rosin Disposable

Snow G is an indica dominant hybrid (65% indica/35% sativa) strain created through a cross of the White Widow X American Indica strains. This bud is often used as a resin due to its tendencies to take on its White Widow mother's characteristics. The Snow G high is much sought after because of its potent effects powered by a high THC level.
